x: We welcome to the club as new members David Owen, David Purdy, Jacob Sanderson, Raymond Hall, Kenneth Hill and George Webb and hope they enjoy our company and hope to swell the numbers at Wimbledon and on the track.
George Webb gained his 6 mile badge, whilst Bob Readman only just missed his 7 mile. Surely Bob has earned the name "Evergreen"- a grand effort.

The handicap was won by our youngest member John Knifton, so "look out the handicapper". George Webb was second and Bert Stevenson third. As this was the first time any of these chaps had won a pot everyone was well pleased.
Our "B" team was completed by Joe Wilson, George Webb and Dan Logan, who suffered from the cold. What a distance man Webb would make with regular training!
